## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Jaén, Spain. It starts at Castillo-Fortaleza de la Mota s/n.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> 'La Fortaleza' often attracts and surprises travelers with its imposing silhouette, history and heritage.
>
> Discover one of Andalusia's most emblematic monuments, and learn about the history of this fortified city which played an important role over the centuries. Contemporary with other iconic sites like the Alhambra and the Mosque of Córdoba, a visit here will provide you with an insightful glimpse into medieval life on the border.
>
> Explore medieval houses, streets, buildings and defensive systems, and transport yourself back into history!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €9.00. It was rated 4.9 out of 5 from 62 ratings and 39 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
